description: This PHP class represents a data transfer object for embedded YouTube URLs within the OrangeHRM Buzz plugin module. It provides functionality to extract and convert various YouTube URL formats into a standard embedded URL.

classes.name: EmbeddedURLForYoutube
classes.description: A subclass extending AbstractBuzzVideoURL that handles parsing and conversion of YouTube URLs into embedded URLs.

methods.name: getEmbeddedURL
methods.description: Extracts and returns a standardized embedded URL for YouTube videos based on the provided URL, or throws an exception if the URL is invalid.
